scope: Heroes VII follow-up audit of recoverable relationships and source-package gaps; this file supplements, but does not replace, heroes7.patch.json.
policy: No shared catalog, schema, database, or GitHub files are modified. Only additions and fills would be mergeable; this follow-up contains no merge rows because the primary sources do not expose the missing values.

buildingRecruitmentAudit.result: No reviewed input explicitly names a warfare creature as recruited by a specific building. The catalog has plausible special-building names and 12 warfare resource-cost rows, but neither a building name nor a cost proves a BuildingCreature edge. The third-party mirror of Ubisoft-authored town-screen posts names some candidate mappings, but is not a primary package/source registry and does not cover all 19 identities. No BuildingCreature additions are therefore emitted.

candidateMissingJunctions.reason: The current catalog has no warfare-building links. The editor manual documents that warfare units are recruitable content, but does not identify each faction's building-to-unit mapping. The mirrored Ubisoft town-screen posts name some mappings, but are not primary game data and do not cover all 19 units.

candidateMissingJunctions.scope: 137 detailed H7 creatures without CreatureAbility links
candidateMissingJunctions.reason: No primary H7 manual or editor documentation in scope enumerates the creature ability-to-creature graph. The official Modding Manual establishes that archetypes hold stats/visuals, but not the final ability assignments. Do not copy visual or wiki-only claims into this junction.

The current catalog has no H7 FactionSpell rows. The official manuals consulted establish magic-school and editor concepts but do not publish a complete faction availability matrix with primary locators.

MapHOMM7 requires LevelCount, MapKind, HasUnderground and HasTearOfAsha. Campaign/scenario names and CampaignScenario ordering are already present, but the primary docs do not expose these per-map values. No map dimensions or underground flags are inferred from names.

All ScenarioHOMM7 fields are optional except the shared key, so emitting 43 empty detail rows would add no information. Victory/loss conditions, starting state, carryover and level caps require scenario/package exports.
